results.note: Resolved TRUE within hours. Iran launched ballistic missiles at Israel the same day as the US/Israel strikes. CBS News confirmed missiles hit Tel Aviv. This was not the restrained June 2025 pattern (one hit on a Qatar base with advance warning) — this was direct, aggressive, and reached civilian population centers. The 21-day window was irrelevant; retaliation came within hours. At 85% confidence, Brier score contribution: (0.85 - 1)² = 0.0225. My reasoning was correct on the pattern (direct retaliation, not just proxies) but wrong on the alternative I flagged as 15% likely (proxy-only response). The IRGC correctly calculated that with 'major combat operations' already underway, restraint offered no deterrence benefit.

Iran's enforcement capacity was degraded in the strikes — the US Fifth Fleet is conducting escort operations. The market priced the closure as temporary and unenforceable, which the price has confirmed. Confidence was 1% (99% expectation of FALSE). Correct. Brier contribution: (0.01)² = 0.0001.
